notes: The clearest documented credit system in the dataset: published character-to-credit mapping, rollover rules, and expiry. Creative-tab pricing recorded; Agents and API have separate pricing tabs (future records).

snapshots.trial: free tier, 10k credits/mo, no commercial license

plans.name: Free
plans.whats_gated: 10k credits/mo, 3 Studio projects, no commercial license

plans.name: Starter
plans.whats_gated: 30k credits, commercial license, instant voice cloning

usage_meters.rate: 1 credit = 1 character (0.5 credits/character on Flash/Turbo models); extra TTS ~$0.36/min (Free tier rate) down to ~$0.17/min (Pro+)

credits_system.credit_definition: 1 credit = 1 character of text-to-speech (0.5 for Flash/Turbo models); ~10 TTS minutes on Free up to ~6,000 on Business
credits_system.credit_to_compute_mapping: Published and transparent: character-based, model-dependent multiplier
credits_system.expiry: Subscription credits roll over up to 2x monthly quota (max 3x balance) while subscribed; PAYG credits expire 12 months after purchase, outside rollover; cancel/downgrade forfeits unused credits

sources.note: Primary pricing page (Creative tab, monthly billing), fetched
Official help center: credit definition and rollover rules (article 27561768104081)
